DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の受付で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you arrange a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 育児と仕事のことで相談したいです。子供を連れて窓口へ行くので、予約が必要か知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 育児と仕事を相談したく、子供同伴で窓口へ行く場合の予約要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about childcare and work. I'll be bringing my child to the counter, so I'd like to know whether I need an appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to discuss childcare and work, and ask whether an appointment is needed when visiting with your child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談内容で担当を確認します。保育の利用についてですか、それとも仕事の探し方についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the appropriate staff based on your questions. Is this about using childcare or about finding work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方ですが、先に保育の利用条件を聞きたいです。仕事の相談は別の担当なら、次に予約します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まず保育の利用条件を聞き、仕事の相談が別担当なら後で予約したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both, but I'd like to ask about childcare eligibility first. If someone else handles work advice, I'll book that afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you first want childcare eligibility advice and will book work advice later if handled by different staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 優先する相談を担当へ伝えます。来られる時間帯と、お子さんの年齢を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the staff which consultation you want to prioritize. Please tell me when you can come and your child's age.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子供は二歳で、午前中なら来られます。面談中に預かってもらえるとは思わず、同伴で相談できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子供は二歳で午前なら来られるが、託児を当然とせず同伴で相談できるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child is two, and I can come in the morning. I won't assume someone can mind my child during the meeting; I'd like to check whether I can consult with my child accompanying me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your child is two and mornings are possible, and you want to check consultation with your child present without assuming childcare is provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から受付条件の回答が来ました。相談は予約が必要で、お子さん同伴はできますが託児はありません。お子さんの様子による途中休憩は相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff have replied about attendance conditions. An appointment is required, and your child may accompany you, but no childcare is provided. You can discuss taking breaks according to your child's needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子供の様子で途中に休憩が必要かもしれません。事前に相談したい内容を紙で送れるかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子供の様子で休憩が必要かもしれず、相談内容を事前に紙で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We may need a break partway through, depending on my child. Please also ask whether I can send my questions on paper in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say a break may be needed depending on your child, and ask whether written consultation topics can be sent in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 事前の紙の送付は受け付けず、当日にメモを持参する案内です。保育の相談を先に、午前で予約希望を伝えてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: They don't accept paper sent in advance; you're asked to bring your notes on the day. May I pass on your request to book childcare advice first, in the morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、保育の相談を午前で希望します。子供と一緒で託児はなく、必要な休憩を相談するのですね。メモは先に送らず当日持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保育利用相談の午前予約を希望し、子供同伴可だが託児なし、休憩は相談でき、メモは送付せず当日持参と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'd like childcare advice in the morning. My child can come, but there is no childcare, and we can discuss any breaks needed, right? I won't send the notes ahead; I'll bring them that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a morning childcare consultation and confirm your child may accompany you, no childcare is provided, breaks can be discussed, and notes must be brought that day rather than sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その希望を記録しました。午前の日時は担当の空き確認待ちです。子供同伴と当日メモ持参の条件を確認できました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've recorded your request. We're waiting for staff to check morning availability. We've confirmed the conditions of bringing your child and notes on the day. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会計の記録について、何をご確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your payment records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週の領収書をなくしました。会社へ費用の申請をするので、支払った記録をもう一度もらえるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週の領収書を紛失し、会社の費用申請に必要な支払記録を再取得できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost last week's receipt. I need to claim the expense from my company, so I'd like to ask whether I can obtain the payment record again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost last week's receipt and ask whether you can obtain the payment record needed for a company expense claim again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受診日とご本人を確認して担当へ照会します。会社が必要としている書類の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll verify your visit date and identity and ask the person in charge. Has your company specified which document it needs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いの証明です。診断書ではありません。領収書の再発行ができない場合に、別の記録でよいか会社にも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要なのは診断書でなく支払証明で、再発行不可なら代替記録でよいか会社にも確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Proof of payment, not a medical certificate. If the receipt can't be reissued, I'd like to check with my company whether another record is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you need proof of payment rather than a medical certificate, and want to ask your company whether an alternative record is acceptable if reissue is impossible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再発行や証明の取扱いは担当に確認します。先週の受診日と支払い方法はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check reissue and certification arrangements with the staff. Do you know last week's visit date and payment method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付はこちらで、カードで払いました。カードの利用記録もありますが、それだけで会社が受け付けるかは未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受診日とカード支払いの記録はあるが、カード記録だけで会社が受理するかは未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the date, and I paid by card. I have the card transaction record too, but haven't checked whether my company will accept that alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the visit date and card-payment record, but have not confirmed whether the company accepts a card record alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計担当から回答が来ました。領収書原本の再発行はできませんが、「支払証明書」は発行できます。カードの利用記録とは別の書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The payment team have replied. The original receipt cannot be reissued, but a 'payment certificate' can be issued. That's a separate document from your card transaction record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日ここで原本と同じ物が出ると思わず、発行できる書類名、費用、受け取り方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ原本が当日再発行されるとは思わず、発行可能な書類名、費用、受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume an identical original will be issued here today. I'd like to ask the name of the available document, its fee, and how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not assume the same original can be reissued today, and ask the available document's name, fee, and collection method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支払証明書は300円で、翌営業日以降にご本人が会計で受け取る取扱いです。今日は同じ領収書を渡すことはできません。会社がこの証明書を認めるか、先に確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The payment certificate costs 300 yen and must be collected by you at the payment counter from the next business day onward. We can't give you the same receipt today. Would you like to first check whether your company accepts this certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支払証明書、300円、翌営業日以降に本人が会計で受取ですね。今日は発行を依頼せず、その条件で会社に確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替は支払証明書で300円、翌営業日以降に本人が会計で受け取ると復唱し、今日は依頼せず会社の承認を確認してから申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: A payment certificate, 300 yen, collected by me at the payment counter from the next business day onward, then. I won't request issuance today; I'll apply after checking those conditions with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that the alternative is a 300-yen payment certificate collected personally at the payment counter from the next business day, and say you will not request it today but apply after company approval. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類名、費用、受取条件をこちらに書きました。今日はまだ発行申込みを受け付けていません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I've written the document name, fee, and collection conditions here. We haven't accepted an issuance application today. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。なくした物について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a missing item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行かばんが見つかりません。タクシーと駅には聞いたので、こちらで紛失を届けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行かばんが見つからずタクシーと駅には照会済みなので、紛失の届出をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my travel bag. I've asked the taxi company and station, so I'd like to report it lost here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your travel bag is missing and you have already asked the taxi company and station, so you want to file a lost-property report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に持っていた場所と、すでに確認した結果を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you last had it and the results of the checks you've already made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: タクシーを降りた時は持っていました。車内にはないと返事があり、駅は確認中です。駅で見つからないと確定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: タクシー降車時は所持し車内にはないとの回答を得たが、駅は確認中で未発見が確定したわけではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had it when I got out of the taxi. They replied it isn't in the car; the station is still checking. It's not confirmed that it wasn't found at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you had it when leaving the taxi and received a reply that it was not inside, but the station is still checking and has not confirmed a negative result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認中と回答済みを分けて記録しましょう。かばんの形、色、特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's record checks in progress separately from replies received. What shape, color, and distinctive features does the bag have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい紺色の旅行かばんです。ファスナーを修理して、引き手に黄色い糸がついています。買った時の写真にはその糸はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺色のかばんでファスナーの引き手に修理後の黄色い糸があり、購入時写真にはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a small navy-blue travel bag. The zipper was repaired, and there's yellow thread on its pull. That thread isn't in the photo from when I bought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the navy bag with yellow thread added to the zipper pull after repair, which is absent from the purchase-time photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の特徴を確認できる写真や、内容の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a photo showing its current features or a record of the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最近の写真があります。中には服と、名前を書いたノートです。パソコン入りのかばんとは別なので、電子機器は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最近の写真を示し、中身は服と記名したノートで、別のかばんにある電子機器は入っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a recent photo. It contains clothes and a notebook with my name. It's different from my computer bag, so there are no electronic devices inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show a recent photo and explain the contents are clothes and a named notebook, not electronic devices kept in another bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録を読み返します。小さい紺色のかばん、修理後の黄色い糸、服と記名ノートで電子機器なし。タクシーは車内なしと回答済み、駅は確認中です。「駅にもなかった」とは記録していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll read back the record. A small navy-blue bag, yellow thread after repair, clothes and a named notebook, no electronics. The taxi company replied it isn't in the car; the station is still checking. I haven't recorded that it wasn't at the station either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その記録で合っています。黄色い糸がある最近の写真を使ってください。駅から返事があれば、確認中の欄を更新できるよう担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修理後の黄色い糸が写る最近の写真を使うよう頼み、駅は確認中という読み返しを確認して返答後に担当へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That record is correct. Please use the recent photo showing the yellow thread. Once the station replies, I'll tell the person in charge so the pending-check field can be updated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to use the recent photo with the repaired yellow thread, confirm the readback that the station is still checking, and say you will tell staff once it replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入時の写真と最近の写真を区別して記録しました。連絡先を確認し、今後の返答も伺います。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I've distinguished the purchase-time photo from the recent one in the record. We'll check your contact details and ask about further replies. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受け取りのことで、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在の通知が二枚あります。まとめてこの窓口で受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在通知が二枚あり、同じ窓口でまとめて受け取れると思って来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two missed-delivery notices. I came thinking I could collect both together at this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have two missed-delivery notices and came expecting to collect them together at the same counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の差出元と配達した会社を確認しましょう。二枚とも郵便の案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the sender and delivery company on each notice. Are both postal notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚は別の宅配会社でした。差出人が同じ店なので、配達する所も同じだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚は別の宅配会社で、差出店が同じため配達元も同じだと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One was from another courier. Since the sender was the same shop, I thought the delivery company was the same too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain one notice is from another courier, but you thought the delivery company matched because the sending shop was the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出人と配達事業者は別です。郵便の通知について、保管先と受け取り条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The sender and delivery operator are separate. For the postal notice, we'll check the storage location and collection conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 郵便のほうは窓口で受け取りたいです。宅配会社のほうは、通知にある連絡先で日時を変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵便の荷物は窓口受取を希望し、別会社の荷物はその通知先へ日時変更を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to collect the postal one at a counter. For the courier one, I'll change the date and time using the contact on its notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request counter collection for the postal parcel and say you will contact the other company's notice contact to change its delivery date and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 郵便物の宛名と必要な本人確認を案内に沿って確認してください。通知だけで必ずお渡しできるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the postal item's addressee and required identification according to the instructions. The notice alone doesn't always mean we can hand it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛名は私です。本人確認書類もありますが、保管先がここかはまだ読んでいません。先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便物は自分宛てで本人確認書類もあるが、この窓口が保管先かは未確認なので調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's addressed to me, and I have identification. But I haven't read whether it's stored here. Please check that first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the postal item is addressed to you and you have identification, but have not confirmed this counter is its storage location, and ask for that to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、保管の表示を確認します。受け取れる場所と日時をご案内した後に、手続きを進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll check the storage information. Let's proceed after explaining where and when you can collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を分け、郵便は保管先と書類を確認して受け取ります。別会社の荷物は別に連絡し、まとめて依頼しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知を分けて郵便の保管先と必要書類を確認し、他社の荷物には別に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separate the two notices and collect the postal one after checking its storage location and documents. I'll contact the other company separately rather than ask for both together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the notices, check the postal storage location and required documents, and contact the other company separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知を区別できましたね。郵便物の確認を進めます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You've distinguished the notices now. We'll proceed with checking the postal item. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。カードについて、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ATMを使った後、カードがありません。機械が回収したかもしれませんが、見ていないので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ATM利用後にカードがなく、機械の回収は見ていないので所在を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: After using the ATM, I no longer have my card. The machine may have retained it, but I didn't see that, so I'd like to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your card is missing after ATM use and you did not witness the machine retain it, so you want to check its whereabouts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用したATMの場所と時刻を教えてください。カードを受け取った記憶はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the ATM location and time of use. Do you remember taking your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この入口の機械を昼ごろ使いました。現金と明細は持っていますが、カードを受け取ったかは曖昧です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の端末を昼頃使い、現金と明細はあるがカードを受け取った記憶は曖昧だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used the machine at this entrance around noon. I have my cash and transaction slip, but I'm uncertain whether I took the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used the entrance machine around noon and have cash and a slip, but your memory of taking the card is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 端末の確認と、カードが手元にない場合の対応を担当へつなぎます。回収されていると決めつけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll connect you with staff to check the machine and advise what to do when you don't have your card. Don't assume it was retained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 誰かが持っている可能性もあるので、まず保護の手続きを相談します。機械の前を探す間も口座を安全にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 第三者が所持している可能性もあるため、所在照会とともに先に保護手続きを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Someone else might have it, so I'd first like to discuss protective procedures. I'd like to keep my account safe while looking around the machine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say a third party may have it, so alongside the location inquiry you first want advice on protective procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な停止などの相談を担当へ伝えます。暗証番号をこちらへ読み上げる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell staff you need advice about suspension or other necessary steps. You don't need to read your PIN aloud to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を言わず、本人確認の案内に従います。明細の時刻はここにあるので、利用した機械の確認に使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 暗証番号は読み上げず本人確認の案内に従い、明細の時刻を端末の確認に使ってほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't say the number, and I'll follow the identification instructions. The time is here on the slip, so please use it to check which machine I used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not read your PIN aloud, will follow identification guidance, and want the slip time used to check the terminal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻と場所を記録します。カードの所在と、今後の手続きは担当から確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record the time and place. The staff will check and tell you the card's whereabouts and the next procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 回収を見ていないと明確に伝え、明細の時刻で照会します。見つかったと確定するまで、保護の案内に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収を目撃していないと説明して時刻と端末を照会し、所在が確定するまでは保護の案内に従うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll clearly say I didn't witness it being retained and inquire using the slip's time. Until it's confirmed found, I'll follow the protection guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain you did not witness retention, inquire by time and terminal, and say you will follow protective guidance until its location is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the person in charge. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お会計で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is something wrong with your checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今いただいたお釣りが多い気がします。財布へ入れる前に、レシートと一緒に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受け取った釣銭が多い気がするため、財布へ入れる前にレシートと照合してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think you've given me too much change. Could you check it against the receipt before I put it in my wallet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the change seems too much and ask for it to be checked against the receipt before putting it in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お支払いの金額と、受け取ったお釣りを教えてください。レシートも拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Please tell me how much you paid and the change you received. I'll look at the receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 千円札を一枚出しました。合計は六百八十円で、いただいたお釣りは八百二十円です。千円から引くと三百二十円のはずだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 千円札一枚で六百八十円を払い、釣銭を八百二十円受け取ったが、差額は三百二十円のはずだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I gave one 1,000-yen note. The total was 680 yen, and I received 820 yen change. I think subtracting it from 1,000 should give 320 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you paid 680 yen with one 1,000-yen note and received 820 yen change, but the difference should be 320 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レシートには、お預かり千五百円と入力されています。実際のお支払いは千円札一枚だけでしたか。追加の硬貨はありませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The receipt has 1,500 yen entered as received. Did you actually pay only one 1,000-yen note? There weren't any extra coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、千円札一枚だけで、硬貨は足していません。受け取った八百二十円は、自分の財布のお金と混ぜず、ここに置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払ったのは千円札だけで追加の硬貨はなく、受取釣銭八百二十円は自分のお金と混ぜず別に置いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, just one 1,000-yen note, with no coins added. I've put the 820 yen here separately, without mixing it with the money in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say payment was only a 1,000-yen note with no extra coins, and the 820-yen change is set apart without mixing with your own money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の確認でも、お預かりは千円でした。入力を訂正します。差の五百円をお返しいただき、残る三百二十円と訂正した控えを一緒に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff also confirmed we received 1,000 yen. I'll correct the entry. Could you return the 500-yen difference, then check the remaining 320 yen together with the corrected slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの五百円を返します。残りは百円玉三枚と十円玉二枚で、三百二十円です。控えのお預かり額も千円になっているか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過剰な五百円を返し、残る百円玉三枚と十円玉二枚が三百二十円で、訂正控えの預り額も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return this 500 yen. What's left is three 100-yen coins and two 10-yen coins, making 320 yen. I'll also check the received amount on the slip is 1,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return the extra 500 yen, the three 100-yen and two 10-yen coins remaining total 320 yen, and you will check the corrected received amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五百円を受け取りました。こちらが訂正した控えです。合計六百八十円、お預かり千円、釣銭三百二十円になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've received the 500 yen. Here's the corrected slip. It shows a total of 680 yen, 1,000 yen received, and 320 yen change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えと手元の三百二十円が合っています。先ほどの控えと訂正した控えを区別し、確認できたお釣りを財布に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正控えと手元の三百二十円が一致すると伝え、古い控えと分けて、確認済みの釣銭を財布へ入れると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The slip matches the 320 yen I have. I'll distinguish the earlier slip from the corrected one and put the verified change in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the corrected slip and the 320 yen in hand match, and you will separate the old slip and put the verified change in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。入力を誤って失礼いたしました。お申し出いただき助かりました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. I'm sorry for the entry error. Your bringing it to our attention helped. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が飲み物を買いに行った間、私が帽子を探しています。落としたのか、家族が持っているのか整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族が席を離れている間に帽子が見当たらなくなり、どこに置いたか整理したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: While my family has gone to buy drinks, I'm looking for my hat. I'd like to work out whether I dropped it or my family has it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your hat is missing while your family is away from the seats, and ask for help organizing where you put it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に帽子を使った時、そのあと誰かへ渡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: When you last used the hat, did you give it to anyone afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベンチで子どもへ渡しました。子どもは家族と一緒なので、先に持っているか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチで子供に帽子を渡したので、一緒にいる家族に持っているか聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I gave it to my child at the bench. My child is with my family, so I'd first like to ask whether they have it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you gave the hat to your child at the bench and will ask the family member with them whether they have it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡できますか。探すためお互い移動し続けず、合流する場所も決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you contact them? Instead of both parties continually moving to search, let's decide where to meet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話で聞いたら、家族のかばんにあるそうです。帽子を探す必要はなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話で確認したところ、家族のかばんに帽子があったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked by phone, and they say it's in my family's bag. I don't need to search for the hat anymore.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that a phone check confirmed the hat is in your family's bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つかりましたね。飲み物を持つ家族とはどこで会いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You've found it, then. Where will you meet your family with the drinks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今いるベンチの場所を伝えます。写真を送るより、二人で見た案内板からの位置を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今いるベンチと近くの案内板を目印に、家族へ待ち合わせ場所を説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them the location of the bench where I am now. Rather than send a photo, I'll describe where it is relative to the information board we both saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to explain the meeting place to your family using your current bench and the nearby information board as landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ場所へ戻れるよう、目印を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the landmarks so you can return to the same place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板とベンチの位置を伝えて待ちます。帽子は家族のかばんにあるので、忘れ物の届出はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族のかばんに帽子があるので届け出は不要で、伝えたベンチで合流を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the board and bench locations and wait. Since the hat is in my family's bag, I won't file a lost-property report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say no report is needed because the hat is in your family's bag, and you will wait to meet at the bench you described. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご家族と合流して、楽しくお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Meet your family and enjoy your time together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符の購入で、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with buying tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族三人で出かけます。三人分の切符を買いたいのですが、娘だけ途中の駅で降ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人分の切符を購入したいが、娘だけ途中駅で降りると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three of us are going out as a family. I'd like three tickets, but only my daughter will get off at an intermediate station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want tickets for three people, but your daughter alone gets off at an intermediate station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの目的地を確認しましょう。娘さんと、ほかのお二人の降りる駅はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check each destination. Which stations will your daughter and the other two get off at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 娘は途中の駅A、私たちはその先の駅Bです。三人分を同じ行き先で買わず、娘一人分をAまでに分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 娘は途中駅Aで両親二人は駅Bまでなので、娘だけAまでの一人分に分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My daughter at intermediate station A, and us at station B farther on. Rather than buy three for the same destination, I'd like to separate one ticket for my daughter as far as A.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your daughter gets off at A while her two parents go to B, so you want a separate one-person ticket only to A. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。娘さんの年齢と、利用する列車の希望も確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please also let me check your daughter's age and your preferred train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 娘は十五歳です。全員同じ列車で一緒に乗り、娘が降りた後も私たちは乗っていたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 娘は十五歳で、全員同じ列車に乗り、娘が降りた後も他の二人は乗り続けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: She's fifteen. We'd all like to board the same train together, and for us to remain on it after she gets off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your daughter is fifteen, everyone will take the same train, and the other two want to remain aboard after she gets off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ列車を使える行き方を確認してから、区間ごとの券を選びましょう。帰りの予定も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check a route allowing the same train before choosing tickets for each section. Are your return plans the same too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは娘が友達と戻るので、娘の帰り分は今日は買いません。私たち二人の帰りだけ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 娘は友人と帰るので娘の復路は買わず、他の二人の復路だけ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My daughter will return with friends, so I won't buy her return ticket today. I'd like to discuss just the return for the two of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your daughter returns with friends, so you will not buy her return ticket and only want return advice for the other two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入内容の下書きを見せます。娘さんはAまで行き一人分、ほかのお二人はBまで行き二人分と帰り二人分です。娘さんの帰りは入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's a draft of the purchase. One outward ticket for your daughter to A, and two outward tickets to B plus two return tickets for the other two. Your daughter's return isn't included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 下書きは合っています。娘はAまで行き一人分、私たちはBまで行き二人分と帰り二人分ですね。全員の往復としては買いません。料金と列車を確認してから購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 娘はAまで行き一人分、両親はBまで行き二人分と帰り二人分で娘の復路なしという下書きを確認し、料金と列車の確認後に購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The draft is correct. One outward ticket for my daughter to A, and two outward to B and two return for us. We won't buy a round trip for everyone. I'll purchase after checking fares and trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the draft of one outward to A for your daughter, two outward to B and two return for the parents, without your daughter's return, and say you will buy after checking fares and trains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、人数と区間の確認ができました。まだ発券や決済はしていません。利用列車と料金を確認して購入に進みましょう。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we've confirmed the people and sections. We haven't issued tickets or taken payment yet. Let's check the trains and fares and proceed to purchase. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。通知について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族宛ての通知が届きました。本人は入院中なので、私が内容と期限を確認してもよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入院中の家族宛ての通知について、自分が内容と期限を確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice addressed to a family member arrived. They're hospitalized, so I'd like to ask whether I can check its contents and deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can check the contents and deadline of a notice addressed to your hospitalized family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名の方と、相談される方を区別して確認します。ご家族から依頼は受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll distinguish the named recipient from the person consulting. Have you been asked to do this by your family member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人から紙を見てほしいと言われました。でも、それだけで私が申請もできるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人には紙を見てほしいと頼まれたが、それだけで申請も代理できるとは考えていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They asked me to look at the paper. But I don't assume that alone means I can apply on their behalf too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the recipient asked you to look at the paper, but you do not assume that alone authorizes you to apply for them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を案内できる範囲と、手続きに必要な本人確認は担当が確認します。期限の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check what information they can provide and the identification needed for procedures. Is a deadline written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この日付です。入院中に期限が来るので、本人が今できることと、私に頼めることを分けて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限は入院中に来るため、本人ができることと家族に頼めることを分けて確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This date. It falls while they're hospitalized, so I'd like to ask separately what they can do now and what they can ask me to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the deadline falls during hospitalization and you want to distinguish what the person can do from what they can ask family to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 事情とご希望を担当へ伝えます。期限の変更や代理の可否は、この場で確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff your circumstances and wishes. I can't guarantee a deadline change or whether representation is allowed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 病院の詳しい情報までここで読み上げず、必要な証明があるなら担当に提出します。先に必要書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病院の詳細を周囲に読み上げず、必要な証明があれば指定方法で提出するので書類を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't read detailed hospital information aloud here. If proof is needed, I'll submit it to the staff. Please first tell me which documents are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not read hospital details aloud around others and will submit any required proof by the specified method, so first ask which documents are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要とする範囲をご案内します。通知の宛名と番号は、指定した方法で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the scope of information the staff need. Let's check the notice's addressee and number by the specified method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族宛てで本人は入院中と伝え、依頼されたのは内容確認だと説明します。期限と代理条件、必要書類を担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と入院、依頼範囲が内容確認であることを伝え、期限、代理条件、必要書類を担当者に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say the notice is for a family member who is hospitalized and explain that I was asked only to check its contents. I'll discuss the deadline, representation conditions, and documents with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the addressee, hospitalization, and that the request covers checking contents, and say you will consult staff about the deadline, representation conditions, and required documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知をお持ちになって担当へご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the notice and consult the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の相談で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your medical consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腕に赤いものが出て、かゆいです。薬を飲み始めた後なので、受付で先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服薬開始後に腕の赤みとかゆみが出たので、受付で先に医療者へ知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Red marks have appeared on my arm and they're itchy. It happened after I started taking medicine, so I'd like to tell reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say redness and itching appeared on your arm after starting medication, and you want medical staff notified at reception first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 医療スタッフへお知らせします。症状が出た時刻と、薬を使い始めた日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll notify medical staff. Please tell me when the symptoms appeared and the day you started the medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薬は一昨日からで、赤いものは今朝気づきました。薬が原因かは自分ではわからないので、時系列で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬は一昨日から、赤みは今朝気づいたので、原因を決めつけず時系列で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The medicine was from the day before yesterday, and I noticed the red marks this morning. I don't know myself whether the medicine caused it, so I'll give the sequence of events.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say medication began the day before yesterday and you noticed redness this morning, explaining the timeline without deciding the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使っている薬が確認できるものはありますか。今つらい症状も医療スタッフへお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have anything to identify the medicine you're using? Please also tell medical staff about symptoms troubling you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳と薬の袋があります。かゆみは昨夜からで、眠れませんでした。赤みは今朝見つけましたが、いつ赤くなったかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お薬手帳と薬袋を示し、かゆみで昨夜眠れず赤みは今朝見つけたが開始時刻は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my medication record book and medicine bag. The itching started last night and kept me from sleeping. I found the redness this morning, but don't know when it actually became red.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your medication book and bag, and say itching prevented sleep last night and redness was found this morning, but its start time is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬は一昨日から、かゆみは昨夜から、赤みに気づいたのは今朝、赤みの開始は不明ですね。この四点を分けて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Medication from the day before yesterday, itching since last night, redness noticed this morning, and redness onset unknown, correct? I'll pass those four points separately to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝気づいたと書き、実際の開始は未確認にします。薬の名前が似ているので、口で略さず袋を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今朝は発見時刻として記録し、開始は未確認とし、似た薬名を略さず袋で確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write that I noticed it this morning and leave the actual start unconfirmed. Since the medicine names are similar, I'll show the bag rather than shorten the name when speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say this morning is recorded as the discovery time while onset remains unconfirmed, and you will have staff check the bag rather than abbreviate similar medicine names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。医療スタッフが確認できるようご用意ください。薬の使い方を変える相談も、担当へ直接お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please have those ready for medical staff to check. Also discuss any changes to medication use directly with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬を始めた日、かゆみ、今朝気づいた赤みを分けて説明します。原因を決めつけず、袋と手帳で確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服薬開始日、かゆみ、赤みに気づいた時刻を分け、原因を断定せず手帳と袋を医療者に示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separately explain the day I started the medicine, itching, and redness noticed this morning. I won't conclude what caused it; I'll have them check using the bag and record book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate medication start, itching, and when redness was noticed, not determine the cause, and show medical staff the book and bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。医療スタッフへご案内します。症状が変わったらすぐお知らせください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to medical staff. Tell us immediately if your symptoms change. Take care.
